controls.control: A requested storage bucket must equal the bucket configured for the current TEST/PRODUCTION environment.

Storage keys reject absolute paths, backslashes, NUL, empty/dot/dot-dot segments, invalid characters and overlong paths; local filesystem paths are resolved and checked to remain within the private root.
Private uploads require a non-empty Buffer within the 1-byte to 10-MB boundary and a declared MIME type validated against an endpoint allowlist.
JPEG, PNG, WebP and PDF file extensions/content signatures must agree with the MIME type; WebP uses RIFF/WEBP magic signature validation.
Customer gallery downloads require a signed, unexpired HMAC URL, timing-safe signature comparison and a database row whose owner matches the signed customer identity.
Driver document downloads require driver/document ownership, the latest document version where the service path is used, and short-lived signed URLs.
Admin document downloads require a drivers VIEW permission check and a scoped document lookup containing both driverId and documentId.
The generic signed URL provider clamp limits requested TTL to 60–900 seconds; sensitive call sites use at most 900 seconds.
Successful Customer Gallery file downloads are audited without raw file bytes or raw storage keys; responses use private no-store cache control and nosniff.

Gallery deletion removes the private storage object before deleting its database pointer, retains the database record when object deletion fails, audits failures, and permits safe retry when the object is already missing.
No comprehensive retention/deletion schedule exists yet for KYC, resumes, support attachments, assets, backups and audit records.
Cross-owner denial, signed-URL expiry, file-signature/MIME/size, storage provider error, cleanup retry and no-orphan/no-loss behavior require final physical/storage tests.

finalRequiredTests: Owner A cannot download Customer B gallery photo with a guessed ID or modified signed link.
Expired gallery link is rejected at the exact expiry second.
Tampered signature and malformed signature lengths are rejected without timing/exception leakage.
Driver A cannot access Driver B KYC document upload or signed URL endpoint.
Admin without drivers VIEW permission cannot request KYC signed URLs.
Older DriverDocument version cannot be downloaded when a newer version is current via the service API.
JPEG/PNG/WebP/PDF valid magic signatures pass only when the file type is allowed for the route.
Fake MIME, wrong extension, truncated magic signature, oversized and empty uploads are rejected.
Requested signed URL TTL below/above range is clamped to 60/900 seconds at the storage boundary.
Production mode fails closed when private storage is not configured and never falls back to local storage.
Deleting gallery photo removes the private object and DB row and writes an audit event without raw object key/content.
Storage deletion failure preserves the DB row and responds retryably; retry is safe if provider object is already missing.
Storage path traversal, wrong environment bucket, local root escape and malformed storage keys are rejected.
Successful signed downloads use private no-store and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff headers.
Retention/deletion policy and orphan reconciliation are reviewed before release.
